description: This Rust source file defines a helper module for calendar operations, including command injection for creating and listing calendar events, and handling these commands by interacting with Google Calendar API. It includes functions for building requests, fetching calendar data, and formatting output.

classes.name: CalendarHelper
classes.description: A helper class implementing calendar-related command injection and handling for Google Calendar API.

methods.name: inject_commands
methods.description: Injects calendar-related commands (+insert and +agenda) into the CLI command structure.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles execution of calendar commands, including inserting events and listing upcoming events.

methods.name: handle_agenda
methods.description: Fetches and displays upcoming calendar events based on specified filters.

methods.name: epoch_to_rfc3339
methods.description: Converts epoch seconds to RFC3339 formatted datetime string.

methods.name: build_insert_request
methods.description: Builds request parameters and body for inserting a new calendar event based on CLI arguments.
